free_tier_limits.correction: Basic (free) includes all signals and endpoints for CAISO_NORTH, plus the CO2 percentile for all regions.

example.correction: The current v3 real-time signal is obtained through GET /v3/forecast, whose first point covers the current five-minute period; /v3/signal-index is not a documented current endpoint.

notes: WattTime's status page showed the API operational on 2026-08-11. Current official sources support v3 forecast and historical grid signals. The legacy v2 reference publishes 3,000 requests per rolling five minutes, but no accessible current official source established that the same limit applies to v3, so the current rate limit remains unverifiable.
